hints.title: Valid Digit Branching
hints.text: Only numbers constructed entirely from valid rotatable digits {0, 1, 6, 8, 9} can possibly be confusing. Recursively construct candidates using only these 5 digits.

hints.title: Rotational Inequality Check
hints.text: For each generated number x <= n, compute its 180-degree rotation. If rotated differs from x, it is a valid confusing number.

hints.title: Leading Digit Pruning
hints.text: Initiate recursion starting with non-zero leading digits {1, 6, 8, 9}. Append digits from {0, 1, 6, 8, 9} while value stays <= n.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: number of digits in n (L <= 9)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating up to n = 10^9 takes O(N) which times out by several orders of magnitude.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating only numbers composed of the 5 valid digits limits search to 5^9 ~ 1.95 million checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only 5 digits can be used and generate candidates recursively.
complexity.notes: 5^9 is small enough to finish within typical time limits.
